intent: Let installed users diagnose executable availability before claiming a task and explain task-only message handling.
core_changes: Standalone --check mode with executable discovery and actionable JSON results
Mutually exclusive check and explicit execution modes
Installed-environment and existing receipt troubleshooting guidance
Offline availability, no-side-effect and CLI boundary tests
contracts: Existing harness packet/result, runner, watcher and Manager contracts retained
Task-only adapter and explicit receipts retained; no new inbox handler
Native discovery is distinct from version/configuration/model validation
No provider routing, account access, retries, takeovers, approvals or publication
tests: Target independently verified imported 14-test adapter suite and config/manifest
Executable path/PATH discovery and missing/nonexecutable diagnostics
No stdin/native/Git/Manager/temp operations in check mode
CLI mutual exclusion and retained explicit execution behavior
Serial full unittest, config/manifest, JSON/YAML and local installed-package smoke
risks: An available executable is not proof of compatible Codex version or model access
The check does not authenticate or invoke the selected executable
Real model and Windows native CI acceptance remain unperformed
Local changes remain unreleased; public push/PR/merge/release is prohibited
